description: Plan + execute a refactor that spans multiple repos owned by the caller. Wraps src/lib/multi-repo-refactor.ts. `dry_run: true` returns the plan only. Requires 'repo' scope.

dry_run.description: When true, returns the plan and does NOT execute.

repository_ids.description: Optional explicit repo IDs to scope the refactor to.

name: gluecron_refactor_across_repos
